queries.note: MECHANISM GOLDMINE. 2604.19117 (12 open-weight models, 5 labs): a small set of attention heads carries a 'this statement is wrong' signal; models register the error and still defer; silencing the heads flips behaviour; the circuit survives RLHF/DPO. This is a causal mechanism for 'noticed but not reported' - identical to MMPCBench's consistency gap.

queries.note: Issue-spotting is the closest EXISTING TASK NAME to our concept, but in LegalBench it is operationalised as a yes/no 'does this post implicate domain X' classification - i.e. a query is supplied.
